title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30222: add handled event before RecreatePurchLines in Pay-to Vendor No. validation
summary: A new handled integration event OnValidatePayToVendorNoOnBeforeRecreatePurchLines was added to the Pay-to Vendor No. field validation in Purchase Header, allowing extensions to take ownership of purchase line recreation logic instead of being forced to replicate the entire validation trigger.
key_points: New integration event raised before RecreatePurchLines call in Pay-to Vendor No. field validation
Event includes IsHandled flag that allows subscribers to skip the standard recreation logic
Exposes Rec and xRec parameters for subscribers to access purchase header data
Applied across all localization layers (W1, APAC, BE, CH, DACH, ES, FI, GB, IT, NA, NL, NO, RU, SE)
Enables custom purchase line recreation logic that preserves extension-specific information
